hero.title: German Language Course in Dehradun: A1 to C2
hero.lead: Start your German training with trainers who prepare you for the Goethe-Zertifikat, the internationally recognised German language certificate. Pick a level below, or take a short level check if you are not sure.

levelsSection.title: Six German courses, A1 to C2

faq.q: Which German level should I start with?
faq.a: Complete beginners start at A1. If you already know some German, a short level check places you in A2 or higher.

faq.q: Do you prepare students for the Goethe-Zertifikat exams?
faq.a: Yes. Every level course follows the syllabus of its Goethe-Zertifikat, and we run mock tests in the real exam format.

faq.q: Are German classes online or offline?
faq.a: Both. You can attend at our Race Course centre in Dehradun or join online, in morning or evening batches, or book personalised sessions.

faq.q: How long does it take to reach B1 or B2?
faq.a: It depends on your starting point and the batch you join. A counsellor can give you a timeline for your goal.

glance.feesAndDuration: Shared on your level check call

level.examIntro: The Goethe exam tests four skills. We train each one in class and in mock tests. Check the Goethe-Institut website for the latest exam format and dates.
